words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 别闹了；住手；别再这样了（常用于要求某人停止某种令人不悦的行为）
words.ex: Cut it out! I'm trying to concentrate.
words.ex_cn: 别闹了！我正努力集中注意力。
words.en: An informal expression used to tell someone to stop doing something that is annoying or unwanted.

words.tr: phrase. 深色色素；暗色颜料
words.ex: The artist used dark pigments to create a somber mood in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家使用深色颜料在画中营造出一种忧郁的氛围。
words.en: Substances used to impart color to materials, especially in the context of art and decoration.

words.tr: phrase. 数据处理；对数据进行收集、存储、操作和呈现的过程
words.ex: The company relies heavily on data process to analyze customer behavior.
words.ex_cn: 公司严重依赖数据处理来分析客户行为。
words.en: The act of performing operations on data to extract meaningful information or to convert it into a desired format.

words.tr: phrase. 白天时间；日光时间；指从日出到日落之间的时段
words.ex: The birds sing during daylight hours.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在白天光线充足的时候鸣叫。
words.en: The period of the day when there is natural light from the sun.

words.tr: phrase. 关于…的争论；对…的辩论
words.ex: There is a debate over homework in school.
words.ex_cn: 学校里对作业存在争论。
words.en: To discuss or argue about a particular subject in a formal manner.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.tr: phrase. 合理的薪酬；体面的工资
words.ex: The job offers decent pay and benefits.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作提供体面的薪酬和福利。
words.en: A decent pay refers to a salary or wage that is considered fair and sufficient to live on, providing a reasonable standard of living.

words.tr: phrase. 对…作出决定
words.ex: They decide on the color for the room.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定房间的颜色。
words.en: To choose something or someone after thinking carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人的精力投入到…中；致力于…
words.ex: He dedicates his energy to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他把精力投入到帮助贫困儿童上。
words.en: To commit one's time and effort to a particular task or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 将……定义为；把……解释为
words.ex: We can define a circle as a shape with all points at the same distance from the center.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以将圆定义为所有点到中心距离相等的形状。
words.en: To state the precise meaning of a word or concept.

words.tr: 短语动词。作出判决；宣判
words.ex: The court will deliver a judgment on the case next week.
words.ex_cn: 法院将于下周对该案件作出判决。
words.en: To officially decide and announce the outcome of a legal case.

words.tr: 短语动词. 宣布裁决；作出判决
words.ex: The jury took three hours to deliver a verdict.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团花了三个小时来宣判。
words.en: When a jury or judge delivers a verdict, they officially state their decision in a court case after considering the evidence.

words.tr: 短语动词. 发表演讲；发表讲话
words.ex: He will deliver a speech at the school meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他将在学校的会议上发表演讲。
words.en: To give a formal talk or presentation to an audience.

words.tr: 短语动词. 发表演讲；讲课；作报告
words.ex: He will deliver a lecture on climate change tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将发表一个关于气候变化的演讲。
words.en: To give a formal talk or presentation, especially as part of a series or course.

words.tr: phrase. 发表讲话；致词
words.ex: He will deliver an address to the students tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将向学生们发表讲话。
words.en: to give a formal speech or statement to an audience

words.tr: phrase. 忍住不享受某物；克制自己不获得某物
words.ex: She denied herself the pleasure of dessert to stay in shape.
words.ex_cn: 她为了保持身材而克制自己不吃甜点。
words.en: To refuse to allow oneself to have or enjoy something.

words.tr: phrase. 克制自己；克制自己的欲望；自我克制
words.ex: He denies himself sweets to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他为了保持健康而不吃甜食。
words.en: To refuse to allow oneself to have or do something, especially something that one would like to have or do.

words.tr: phrase. 系主任；部门负责人
words.ex: The department chair speaks to students every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 系主任每周一和学生谈话。
words.en: The person who is in charge of a department in a college or university, responsible for its administration and academic programs.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；取决于
words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: v. 耗尽；使衰竭；
words.ex: The drought depletes the water supply.
words.ex_cn: 干旱耗尽了水源。
words.en: If you deplete something, you reduce the amount of it that is available or that exists.

words.tr: 短语动词. 沉积一层沉积物
words.ex: The river deposits a layer of sediment when it floods.
words.ex_cn: 河流泛滥时会沉积一层泥沙。
words.en: To lay down a layer of sediment, typically in a geological or environmental context.

words.tr: phrase. 消化系统
words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food in the body.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统在体内分解食物。
words.en: The group of organs that break down food into smaller components that can be absorbed into the bloodstream and used by the body.

words.tr: phrase. 非常便宜的；廉价的
words.ex: The car was dirt cheap, but it needed a lot of repairs.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车非常便宜，但它需要大量的维修。
words.en: If you say that something is dirt cheap, you mean that it is very cheap indeed.

words.tr: phrase. 讨论课；研讨课（一种以学生讨论为主要形式的教学课程）
words.ex: The professor led a lively discussion class on contemporary literature.
words.ex_cn: 教授引导了一堂关于当代文学的生动讨论课。
words.en: A discussion class is a type of class in which students are encouraged to actively participate in discussions about the topic being studied.

words.tr: phrase. 一次性纸杯
words.ex: The event provided disposable paper cups for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 活动为客人提供了用后即丢的一次性纸杯。
words.en: A disposable paper cup is a cup made out of paper and often lined with plastic or wax to prevent liquid from leaking out or soaking through the paper. It is designed for a single use and then to be thrown away.

words.tr: phrase. 独特的特征；显著的特性
words.ex: Her distinctive characteristic is her ability to remain calm in stressful situations.
words.ex_cn: 她独特的特点是在压力大的情况下仍能保持冷静。
words.en: A distinctive characteristic is a feature or quality that makes someone or something clearly different from others.

words.tr: phrase. 区别性特征；独特的性质或特点
words.ex: This phone has a distinctive feature: it folds in half.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个独特的特点：它可以对折。
words.en: A distinctive feature is a characteristic that makes something clearly different from other things of the same type.

words.tr: v. 使有别于；区分；
words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.tr: phrase. 歪曲历史；篡改历史事实
words.ex: He tries to distort history to fit his story.
words.ex_cn: 他试图歪曲历史以符合他的说法。
words.en: To distort history means to change or misrepresent historical facts or events, often to serve a particular agenda or to mislead people.

words.tr: v. 扭曲；歪曲；
words.ex: The mirror distorts my face.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子扭曲了我的脸。
words.en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

words.tr: phrase. 分配中心
words.ex: The goods arrive at the distribution center every morning.
words.ex_cn: 货物每天早上到达配送中心。
words.en: A distribution center is a facility used to store goods which are to be distributed to retailers, to wholesalers, or directly to consumers. It is a key part of the order fulfillment process.

words.tr: 短语动词. 开始积极参与；立刻投入（某事）
words.ex: He decided to dive in and start the project.
words.ex_cn: 他决定投身进去，开始这个项目。
words.en: To start doing something with enthusiasm and energy, often without much preparation.

words.tr: phrase. 分成；除尽
words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate or split something into parts or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 帮某人一个忙
words.ex: Can you do me a favor and close the door?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我个忙，把门关上吗？
words.en: To do something for someone else to help them, often something that they cannot do for themselves.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相处；忍受；处理；与…有关；需要；想做
words.ex: I don't know how to do with him; he is always quiet.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么和他相处；他总是很安静。
words.en: To have a connection or relevance to a particular subject or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 宿舍区；寝室区域
words.ex: He lives in the dormitory area near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 他住在靠近校园的宿舍区。
words.en: A dormitory area is a section or part of a campus or institution where dormitories are located, providing living quarters for students.

words.tr: phrase. 宿舍管理员；负责管理学生宿舍的工作人员
words.ex: The dormitory officer checks the rooms every night.
words.ex_cn: 宿舍管理员每晚检查房间。
words.en: A dormitory officer is a person responsible for the supervision and management of a dormitory, ensuring the safety and well-being of its residents.

words.tr: phrase. 许多的；数十个
words.ex: There are dozens of apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有很多苹果。
words.en: If you refer to dozens of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

words.tr: phrase. 论文的草稿；文章的初稿
words.ex: He is writing a draft of paper for his class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为课程写一篇论文的初稿。
words.en: An initial or preliminary version of a written document, such as an article or report.

words.tr: phrase. 拖延；磨蹭；故意放慢行动
words.ex: He always drags his feet when it's time to do homework.
words.ex_cn: 每次到做作业的时候，他总是拖拖拉拉。
words.en: If you say that someone is dragging their feet, you mean that they are unnecessarily delaying taking action about something.

words.tr: phrase. 剧烈的气候变化；指气候在短时间内发生显著且强烈的变化
words.ex: The desert has drastic climatic variation between day and night.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠白天和夜晚的气候差异极大。
words.en: A severe and significant change in climate patterns over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使分离；离间；使疏远
words.ex: The argument drove them apart.
words.ex_cn: 那次争吵使他们疏远了。
words.en: To cause people or things to separate or become estranged from each other.

words.tr: 短语动词. 使……被充分理解；把……讲清楚；驱车回家
words.ex: He drove home after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后开车回家。
words.en: To make something clearly understood, especially by repeating it or explaining it in a very forceful way.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人发狂；令某人无法忍受
words.ex: The loud music drives me up the wall.
words.ex_cn: 这刺耳的音乐让我快疯了。
words.en: To make someone extremely annoyed or angry

words.tr: phrasal verb. 顺便访问；顺道拜访
words.ex: I will drop by your house after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去你家拜访。
words.en: To visit someone casually and usually without having arranged it before.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 把某人送到某地后离开；让某人下车
words.ex: I will drop my brother off at school.
words.ex_cn: 我会送我弟弟去学校。
words.en: To take someone to a place by car and leave them there.

words.tr: phrase. 药品贸易；毒品交易
words.ex: The police stopped the drug trade in the city.
words.ex_cn: 警方制止了这座城市里的毒品交易。
words.en: The illegal buying and selling of drugs.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；应归于
words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 尘卷风；小型旋风，通常在干燥地区由阳光加热地面而形成，卷起尘土和碎片
words.ex: A dust devil spun across the dry field.
words.ex_cn: 一个尘卷风在干涸的田野上旋转。
words.en: A small whirlwind or air vortex over land, visible as a column of dust and debris.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望得到……的；热切希望……的
words.ex: He is eager for a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望拥有一辆新自行车。
words.en: If you are eager for something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热切的；
words.ex: The children are eager to open their presents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们渴望打开他们的礼物。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望做...
words.ex: He is eager to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他急切地想做作业。
words.en: If you are eager to do something, you want to do it very much.

words.tr: 短语动词. 作为……而赢得声誉；以……著称
words.ex: He earns a reputation as a kind man.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了善良之人的声誉。
words.en: To gain recognition or esteem for being something or doing something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 作为……而获得声誉；以……而闻名
words.ex: He gains a reputation as a kind man.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了好心人的名声。
words.en: To become known or recognized for a particular quality or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 作为……而建立声誉；以……的身份出名
words.ex: He works hard to establish a reputation as a good worker.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，以树立一个好员工的声誉。
words.en: To become known or recognized for a particular quality or achievement.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 逐渐侵蚀；慢慢毁坏（尤指通过化学作用或持续影响）
words.ex: The acid will eat away the metal over time.
words.ex_cn: 酸会逐渐腐蚀金属。
words.en: To gradually destroy or erode something through the process of eating or corroding.

words.tr: phrase. 生态平衡
words.ex: The forest keeps the ecological balance.
words.ex_cn: 森林维持着生态平衡。
words.en: Ecological balance refers to the state of equilibrium within a community of organisms in which genetic, species, and ecosystem diversity remain relatively stable, subject to gradual changes through natural succession.

words.tr: phrase. 生态灾难；生态灾害
words.ex: The oil spill caused an ecological disaster.
words.ex_cn: 石油泄漏导致了一场生态灾难。
words.en: An ecological disaster is a catastrophic event that leads to severe damage to the natural environment and the ecosystems within it, often resulting in long-term harm to the biodiversity and the ecological balance.

words.tr: phrase. 经济状况；经济条件
words.ex: The economic conditions are getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在变得更糟。
words.en: The state of the economy in terms of the production and consumption of goods and services and the supply of money.

words.tr: phrase. 经济危机；指经济活动中出现严重衰退、失业率上升、金融市场动荡等情况
words.ex: The country faced an economic crisis last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家遭遇了经济危机。
words.en: An economic crisis is a situation in which the economy of a country experiences a sudden downturn brought on by a financial crisis.

words.tr: phrase. 经济视角；从经济角度看待问题的方式
words.ex: He sees the problem from an economic perspective.
words.ex_cn: 他从经济的角度看待这个问题。
words.en: An economic perspective involves analyzing situations or issues with a focus on economic factors, such as costs, benefits, and impacts on the economy.

words.tr: phrase. 有效措施
words.ex: The government took effective measures to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取了有效的措施来减少污染。
words.en: Effective measures refer to actions or strategies that produce a desired result or effect, especially in solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 有效的补救措施；有效的补救方法
words.ex: This medicine is an effective remedy for headaches.
words.ex_cn: 这种药是治疗头痛的有效方法。
words.en: An effective remedy is a solution or treatment that successfully solves a problem or cures a disease.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr: phrase. 电费账单
words.ex: He paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天交了电费。
words.en: An electric bill is a statement of the amount of money owed for electricity used in a particular period.

words.tr: phrase. 电脉冲；电冲动（指在神经系统中传递信号的短暂电活动）
words.ex: The brain sends electrical impulses to the muscles.
words.ex_cn: 大脑向肌肉发送电信号。
words.en: Electrical impulses are signals transmitted through the nervous system, consisting of rapid changes in electric potential across a membrane.

words.tr: phrase. 电信号；电脉冲（用于传递信息的电流或电压变化）
words.ex: The brain sends electrical signals to the muscles.
words.ex_cn: 大脑向肌肉发送电信号。
words.en: Electrical signals are the means by which information is transmitted in the nervous system and in electronic devices, through the movement of electrons.

words.tr: phrase. 电子工程（研究电子电路、设备和系统的设计与应用的工程学科）
words.ex: He is studying electronics engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习电子工程。
words.en: Electronics engineering is a discipline that integrates the principles of electrical engineering and computer science to develop electronic devices, circuits, and systems. It involves the design, testing, and production of electronic equipment used in various industries.

words.tr: phrase. 小学
words.ex: He went to elementary school in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他曾在纽约上小学。
words.en: An elementary school is a school for children in their first few years of education, especially those between the ages of 5 and 11.

words.tr: n. 提升；海拔；
words.ex: The elevation of his skills helped him get a better job.
words.ex_cn: 他技能的提升帮助他找到了一份更好的工作。
words.en: The height to which something is elevated or to which it rises.

words.tr: phrase. 雇佣中介；职业介绍所
words.ex: He found a job through an employment agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家职业介绍所找到了工作。
words.en: An employment agency is a business that helps people to find jobs and employers to find suitable workers.

words.tr: phrase. 遇到困难；遭遇难题
words.ex: He encounters difficulties when solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解数学题时遇到困难。
words.en: To face or experience problems or challenges.

words.tr: phrase. 遇到危险；面临危险
words.ex: They may encounter danger when walking alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚上独自走路时可能会遇到危险。
words.en: To come upon or experience danger.

words.tr: phrase. 遇到麻烦；遭遇困难
words.ex: He encounter trouble when he lose his passport.
words.ex_cn: 当他丢失护照时遇到了麻烦。
words.en: To experience or face difficulties or problems.

words.tr: phrase. 遇到反对；遭到抵制
words.ex: He will encounter opposition if he tries to change the rules.
words.ex_cn: 如果他试图改变规则，将会遇到反对。
words.en: To face or experience resistance or disagreement from others.

words.tr: phrase. 鼓励某人去做某事
words.ex: My mom encourages me to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈鼓励我努力学习。
words.en: To give someone support, confidence, or hope to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.tr: phrase. 濒危物种
words.ex: Pandas are endangered species.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是濒危物种。
words.en: An endangered species is a type of organism that is at risk of extinction due to a rapid decrease in its population or a loss of its critical habitat.

words.tr: phrase. 能量源
words.ex: The sun is a clean energy source.
words.ex_cn: 太阳是一个清洁的能源。
words.en: An energy source is a substance or phenomenon that can be used to produce energy, such as coal, oil, wind, or sunlight.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于；参加
words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: 短语动词. 喜欢与某人作伴；享受与某人在一起的时光
words.ex: He enjoys the company of his friends after work.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢下班后和朋友们在一起。
words.en: To like being with someone and spending time with them.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢与某人相处；享受某人的陪伴
words.ex: I enjoy my friend's company during weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我在周末喜欢和朋友待在一起。
words.en: To take pleasure in being with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 巨大的开支；庞大的支出
words.ex: The government made an enormous expenditure on the new highway.
words.ex_cn: 政府在新高速公路上花费了巨额资金。
words.en: An enormous expenditure refers to a very large amount of money spent on something.

words.tr: v. 娱乐；使快乐；款待；
words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.tr: phrase. 环境问题
words.ex: This town has a serious environmental issue with dirty water.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有严重的水质污染问题。
words.en: An environmental issue refers to problems related to the natural world that are caused by human activities and that affect the health and well-being of all living things.

words.tr: phrase. 环境科学课程
words.ex: He takes an environmental science class every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一上环境科学课。
words.en: A course of study that focuses on the interaction between humans and the environment, including the study of ecosystems, environmental policies, and sustainability.

words.tr: phrase. 删除数据；擦除信息
words.ex: He will erase data from the old phone.
words.ex_cn: 他将从旧手机上删除数据。
words.en: To permanently remove or delete digital information from a storage medium.

words.tr: phrase. 逃离；从……逃脱
words.ex: The boy tried to escape from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩试图从着火的房子里逃出来。
words.en: To get away from a place or a situation that is dangerous, unpleasant, or difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 即使
words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管
words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.tr: phrase. 即使在现在
words.ex: Even now, he remembers his first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 即使到现在，他仍然记得上学的第一天。
words.en: At the present moment, despite the time that has passed.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.tr: phrase. 互致问候
words.ex: They exchange greetings every morning at work.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在工作时互相问候。
words.en: To exchange greetings means to say hello or express good wishes to someone when you meet them.

words.tr: phrase. 执行摘要；高层摘要（通常指报告或计划书开头的简要概述，供决策者快速了解主要内容）
words.ex: He wrote an executive summary for the report.
words.ex_cn: 他为这份报告写了一份执行摘要。
words.en: An executive summary is a brief overview or summary of a report, business plan, or proposal, designed to give readers a quick preview of its content.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底讨论或研究某个主题，使其所有方面都被详尽探讨
words.ex: He exhausted a subject by talking too much about it.
words.ex_cn: 他因为说了太多关于这个话题的话而把话题说完了。
words.en: To completely use up or deplete a topic, leaving no further aspects to explore.

words.tr: phrase. 外来的植物；异国的植物
words.ex: He bought an exotic plant from the market.
words.ex_cn: 他从市场上买了一种异域植物。
words.en: An exotic plant is a plant that is not native to the place where it is found, often introduced from a different country or continent.

words.tr: phrase. 扩大生产力；发展生产力量
words.ex: The government wants to expand productive forces to create more jobs.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望扩大生产力以创造更多就业机会。
words.en: To increase or develop the capacity for production, often in an economic or industrial sense.

words.tr: phrase. 除…之外；若不是
words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: phrase. 实验站；试验站
words.ex: The scientists work at an experimental station.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们在一个实验站工作。
words.en: A place where scientific experiments are conducted, especially in agriculture or other applied sciences.

words.tr: phrase. 爆炸性新闻
words.ex: The explosive news shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这则爆炸性新闻让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: News that is very surprising or shocking and likely to cause a strong reaction.

words.tr: phrase. 爆炸性的局势；极易激化的紧张局面
words.ex: The tension in the room made an explosive situation.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的紧张气氛制造了一个爆炸性的局面。
words.en: A situation that is likely to become violent or dangerous very quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 使暴露于……；使接触……；使面临……
words.ex: Parents should expose children to books early.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该让孩子从小接触书籍。
words.en: To make something vulnerable or subject to something else, often negative.

words.tr: phrase. 延长截止日期
words.ex: The teacher will extend the deadline for the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师会延长作业的截止日期。
words.en: To extend the deadline means to make the time by which something must be done or completed longer than originally planned.

words.tr: phrase. 已灭绝的物种
words.ex: Dinosaurs are extinct species.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙是已灭绝的物种。
words.en: An extinct species is a species that no longer exists.

words.tr: phrase. 额外的票；附加票券
words.ex: He bought an extra ticket for his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他为朋友买了一张额外的票。
words.en: A ticket that is additional to the standard or required one, often for an event or travel.

words.tr: phrase. 提取纤维素
words.ex: They extract the cellulose from wood to make paper.
words.ex_cn: 他们从木材中提取纤维素来制造纸张。
words.en: To separate and obtain cellulose, a plant-based material, from other substances.

words.tr: phrase. 微弱的希望；渺茫的希望
words.ex: He has a faint hope that he will pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他 barely 有希望通过考试。
words.en: A very small or slight chance that something desired will happen.

words.tr: phrase. 微弱的可能性；渺茫的希望
words.ex: There is a faint possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨，但可能性很小。
words.en: A faint possibility refers to a very small chance that something might happen.

words.tr: phrase. 微弱的可能；渺茫的机会
words.ex: There is a faint chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的可能性很小。
words.en: A very small possibility of something happening.

words.tr: phrase. 公平评论；公正的意见（通常指在新闻报道或言论中基于事实的合理评论，受法律保护）
words.ex: The critic's review was a fair comment on the movie.
words.ex_cn: 评论家对这部电影的评价是公正的评论。
words.en: A remark or criticism that is considered to be reasonable and not defamatory.

words.tr: phrase. 公正审判；公平的审讯
words.ex: Everyone deserves a fair trial.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都应享有公正的审判。
words.en: A fair trial is a legal proceeding that is conducted justly and impartially, ensuring that all parties are treated equally and that the rights of the accused are protected.

words.tr: phrase. 对...的信任
words.ex: He has faith in his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他相信他的兄弟。
words.en: Trust or confidence in someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 崩溃；瓦解；破裂
words.ex: The old chair will fall apart if you sit on it.
words.ex_cn: 如果你坐在那把旧椅子上，它就会散架。
words.en: If something falls apart, it breaks into pieces because it is old or badly made.

words.tr: phrase. 求助于；退到；转而依靠
words.ex: He will fall back on his savings if he loses his job.
words.ex_cn: 如果他失业了，他会依靠自己的储蓄。
words.en: To rely on something or someone for help or support, especially when other options have failed.

words.tr: phrase. 落后；拖欠
words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.tr: phrase. 跌落；下降
words.ex: The book fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 书从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: If something falls off, it becomes detached from something to which it was attached.

words.tr: phrase. 吵架；失和；掉落；离队
words.ex: They fell out over a small argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为一个小争执吵翻了。
words.en: If people fall out, they have an argument and are no longer friendly.

words.tr: phrase. v. （计划、安排等）失败，落空，未能实现
words.ex: Their plan to go on vacation will fall through if they don't save enough money.
words.ex_cn: 如果他们没有存够钱，他们的度假计划就会落空。
words.en: If an agreement, plan, or deal falls through, it fails to happen or be completed.

words.tr: phrase. v. （计划、安排等）失败，落空，未能实现
words.ex: Their plan to go on vacation will fall through if they don't save enough money.
words.ex_cn: 如果他们没有存够钱，他们的度假计划就会落空。
words.en: If an agreement, plan, or deal falls through, it fails to happen or be completed.

words.tr: phrase. 想要；感觉像；觉得
words.ex: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination for something; to have a sensation or impression of being a certain way.

words.tr: phrase. 实地研究；现场调查；田野调查
words.ex: The anthropologist conducted a field study to understand local customs.
words.ex_cn: 人类学家进行了实地研究，以了解当地的习俗。
words.en: A field study is a research method that involves observing and interacting with subjects in their natural environment to collect data.

words.tr: phrase. （学生）实地考察旅行
words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr: adj. 凶猛的；凶狠的；
words.ex: The fierce lion chased the deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只凶猛的狮子追赶着鹿。
words.en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.tr: phrase. 填写；长胖；变大
words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.tr: phrase. 用……填满；充满……
words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full.

words.tr: phrase. 期末考试；最终考试
words.ex: He is preparing for the final exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为期末考试做准备。
words.en: A final exam is a test given at the end of a course of study to determine the student's knowledge and understanding of the material.

words.tr: phrase. 最终成绩；期末评分
words.ex: He got a final grade of A in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学中得到了最终成绩A。
words.en: The final grade is the overall mark or score that a student receives at the end of a course or academic period, reflecting their performance and achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 最终论文；期末论文
words.ex: He is writing his final paper this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周正在写他的期末论文。
words.en: The last major assignment or project required for a course, typically a research paper or essay.

words.tr: v. 确定；定案；最终确定
words.ex: He will finalize the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会最终确定这个计划。
words.en: To finalize something means to complete all the arrangements for it, especially by discussing it with other people involved.

words.tr: phrase. 金融机构
words.ex: He deposited money in a financial institution.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存入了一家金融机构。
words.en: A financial institution is a company that focuses on dealing with financial transactions, such as investments, loans, and deposits.

words.tr: phrase. 财务计划
words.ex: He made a financial plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个财务计划来存钱。
words.en: A financial plan is a comprehensive evaluation of an individual's current and future financial state by using currently known variables to predict future cash flows, asset values and withdrawal plans.

words.tr: phrase. 金融监管；对金融机构和市场的监督与管理
words.ex: The government enforces financial regulation to protect consumers.
words.ex_cn: 政府实施金融监管以保护消费者。
words.en: Financial regulation refers to the laws and rules that govern the financial industry, designed to maintain the integrity of the financial system and protect consumers.

words.tr: 短语动词. 找到做某事的方法；设法完成某事
words.ex: He wants to find a way to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想找到一种修自行车的方法。
words.en: To discover or devise a method or solution to achieve a particular goal.

words.tr: phrase. 查明；弄清
words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.tr: 短语动词. 找到做某事的方法；设法找到解决问题的途径
words.ex: He tries to find ways to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力寻找省钱的方法。
words.en: Discover methods or solutions to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 完成卷装材料的加工或使用；结束一卷（如胶带、纸张等）的使用
words.ex: He will finish the roll after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会完成这个卷筒。
words.en: Complete the entire amount of something, often food or a roll of material.

words.tr: phrase. 结束与……的关系；处理完某事物
words.ex: He finishes with his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: End a relationship or association with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 最后的润饰；点睛之笔
words.ex: He added a finishing touch to the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他给这幅画加了最后的润色。
words.en: The final detail or action that completes something and makes it perfect.

words.tr: v. 修理；固定；确定；
words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.tr: phrase. 解决问题；修复故障
words.ex: He will fix the problem tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会解决这个问题。
words.en: Resolve or correct an issue or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 与……约定时间；与……安排会面
words.ex: I will fix an appointment with my doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要和我的医生约好时间。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation with someone at a specific time.

words.tr: phrase. 与……预约；与……约定会面
words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要和医生预约。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation with someone at a specific time.

words.tr: n. 风味；味道；特色；
words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.tr: phrase. 灵活的时间安排；可调整的日程
words.ex: He has a flexible schedule at his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在新工作中有灵活的时间安排。
words.en: A flexible schedule is a work arrangement that allows employees to vary their arrival and departure times, and sometimes even the days they work, to better accommodate personal needs and responsibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 弹性工作时间
words.ex: He has flexible working hours so he can leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他有灵活的工作时间，所以可以早点离开。
words.en: Flexible working hours refer to a work schedule that allows employees to vary their start and end times, rather than following a fixed schedule.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.tr: phrase. 食物过敏
words.ex: He has a food allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生有食物过敏。
words.en: An adverse immune response to certain foods.

words.tr: phrase. 食物链
words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.tr: phrase. 食品包装；食物包裹
words.ex: The food package is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 食品包装在桌子上。
words.en: A container or wrapping in which food is stored, transported, and sold.

words.tr: 短语. 为不时之需；以备将来困难时使用
words.ex: He saved some money for a rainy day.
words.ex_cn: 他存了一些钱以备不时之需。
words.en: If you save something, especially money, for a rainy day, you save it for a time in the future when you might need it.

words.tr: phrase. 一会儿；暂时
words.ex: He slept for a while.
words.ex_cn: 他睡了一会儿。
words.en: For a period of time; not permanently.

words.tr: phrase. 世世代代
words.ex: They have lived here for generations.
words.ex_cn: 他们世代住在这里。
words.en: For generations means for a very long time, typically referring to several generations of people.

words.tr: phrase. 例如；比如
words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr: phrase. 徒劳地；免费地；一无所得
words.ex: He worked hard, but it was for nothing.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作了，但却是徒劳的。
words.en: If you say that something was for nothing, you mean that it was not worth doing because you did not achieve anything by doing it.

words.tr: 为了某人的缘故；看在某人的份上
words.ex: I did it for your sake.
words.ex_cn: 我为了你才这么做的。
words.en: If you do something for someone's sake, you do it in order to help them or make them happy.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…
words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 出售；待售
words.ex: The bike is for sale.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车待售。
words.en: If something is for sale, it is being offered to people to buy.

words.tr: phrase. 出于某种原因；不知为什么
words.ex: He left early, for some reason.
words.ex_cn: 他早早离开了，不知为什么。
words.en: used to say that you do not know the reason for something

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr: phrase. 为了……的利益；为了帮助……
words.ex: He did it for the benefit of the community.
words.ex_cn: 他这样做是为了社区的利益。
words.en: If you do something for the benefit of someone, you do it in order to help them or be useful to them.

words.tr: phrase. 为了某人的利益；为某人的好处
words.ex: He exercises every day for his benefit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天锻炼是为了自己的好处。
words.en: For the advantage or well-being of someone.

words.tr: phrase. 暂时
words.ex: He is living with his parents for the time being.
words.ex_cn: 他目前和父母住在一起。
words.en: For the time being means for the present, until some other arrangement is made.

words.tr: 短语. 为了全世界；无论如何（常用于强调决心或假设）
words.ex: I wouldn't do that for the world.
words.ex_cn: 我无论如何也不会做那件事。
words.en: In relation to the entire planet or all of humanity.

words.tr: phrase. 强行赶出；迫使离开；挤走
words.ex: They force out the old manager.
words.ex_cn: 他们把老经理赶走了。
words.en: To compel someone to leave a place or position, often against their will.

words.tr: v. 制定；
words.ex: The teacher will formulate a new rule for class.
words.ex_cn: 老师将制定一条新的课堂规则。
words.en: If you formulate something such as a plan or proposal, you invent it, thinking about the details carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 特许经营店；加盟商店
words.ex: The company plans to open 50 new franchise stores next year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司计划明年开设50家新的特许经营店。
words.en: A franchise store is a retail outlet that operates under the brand and business model of a franchisor, which grants the franchisee the rights to operate the store in exchange for a fee and a share of the profits.

words.tr: phrase. 自由诗；不拘格律的诗歌
words.ex: The poet's latest collection is composed entirely of free verse.
words.ex_cn: 这位诗人的最新诗集完全由自由诗组成。
words.en: Free verse is poetry that does not rhyme or have a regular rhythm.

words.tr: phrase. 冻结
words.ex: The lake will freeze over in winter.
words.ex_cn: 湖水在冬天会结冰。
words.en: If something freezes over, it becomes covered with ice.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （因紧张、害怕或寒冷）僵住，呆住；（机器）因寒冷而停止运转
words.ex: My computer freeze up when I open too many programs.
words.ex_cn: 当我打开太多程序时，我的电脑就会卡住。
words.en: To become very cold and turn into ice, or to stop moving or functioning because of the cold.

words.tr: phrase. 从生物学的角度来看
words.ex: From a biology perspective, understanding the genetic basis of diseases is crucial.
words.ex_cn: 从生物学的角度来看，理解疾病的遗传基础至关重要。
words.en: From the viewpoint of the biological sciences.

words.tr: phrase. 从现在开始；从此
words.ex: From now on, I will study every day.
words.ex_cn: 从现在开始，我会每天学习。
words.en: Starting from this moment and continuing into the future.

words.tr: phrase. 燃油效率；燃料利用率
words.ex: Improving fuel efficiency is a key goal in automotive engineering.
words.ex_cn: 提高燃料效率是汽车工程中的一个关键目标。
words.en: Fuel efficiency refers to the efficiency of the process that converts chemical potential energy contained in a carrier (fuel) into kinetic energy or work.

words.tr: phrase. 全额退款
words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.tr: phrase. 全额奖学金
words.ex: He got a full scholarship to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了全额奖学金来学习工程。
words.en: A full scholarship is a financial award that covers all the costs of attending a university or college, including tuition, books, and sometimes living expenses.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人在某事上非常愤怒的；极为生气的
words.ex: She was furious with him at the way he handled the situation.
words.ex_cn: 她对他处理事情的方式非常生气。
words.en: Extremely angry with someone because of something.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾桶；废物箱
words.ex: He threw the trash into the garbage can.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A garbage can is a container for waste material.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾桶；垃圾箱
words.ex: Please throw the trash in the garbage bin.
words.ex_cn: 请把垃圾扔进垃圾箱。
words.en: A garbage bin is a container for waste disposal, typically found in homes, offices, and public spaces, used to hold trash until it is collected for disposal or recycling.

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.tr: phrase. 代沟；指不同世代之间在思想、价值观或行为方式上的差异
words.ex: Parents and children often disagree because of the generation gap.
words.ex_cn: 父母和孩子经常因为代沟而产生分歧。
words.en: A generation gap is a difference in attitudes, behaviors, and preferences between people of different generations, often leading to a lack of understanding or conflict.

words.tr: phrase. 基因检测
words.ex: Genetic testing can identify mutations that increase the risk of developing certain diseases.
words.ex_cn: 基因检测可以识别增加某些疾病发病风险的突变。
words.en: Genetic testing refers to the analysis of DNA, RNA, chromosomes, proteins, and certain metabolites in order to detect heritable disease-related genotypes, mutations, phenotypes, or karyotypes for clinical purposes.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有机会；得以做某事
words.ex: I hope I get a chance to visit Paris someday.
words.ex_cn: 我希望有一天有机会去巴黎。
words.en: To have the opportunity to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……有理解；掌握；把握
words.ex: He has a grasp on basic math now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在掌握了基础数学。
words.en: To understand or have knowledge about something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得一份工作邀请；得到一个工作机会
words.ex: He got a job offer from a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了一家大公司的录用通知。
words.en: Receive an offer of employment.

words.tr: 短语动词. 从……中获益很多；从……中得到很大乐趣或收获
words.ex: You can get a lot out of reading books.
words.ex_cn: v. 你可以从阅读书籍中获得很多。
words.en: To derive a great deal of benefit, enjoyment, or learning from something.

words.tr: phrase. 获得退款
words.ex: He got a refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为那部坏手机拿到了退款。
words.en: Obtain money back for a returned or unsatisfactory purchase.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭便车；搭车
words.ex: I will get a ride from my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我会搭我哥哥的车。
words.en: To be transported somewhere by someone else in their vehicle.

words.w: get a scholarship to the university
words.tr: 短语. 获得大学奖学金
words.uk: ɡet ə ˈskɒləʃɪp tuː ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsɪti
words.us: ɡet ə ˈskɑːlərʃɪp tuː ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsɪti
words.ex: She worked hard and managed to get a scholarship to the university.
words.ex_cn: 她努力学习，成功获得了大学的奖学金。
words.en: Be awarded financial aid to attend a university.

words.tr: phrase. v. 最终找到时间做某事；抽空做某事
words.ex: I finally got around to cleaning the garage last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我终于在上周末抽出时间清理了车库。
words.en: If you get around to doing something that you have delayed doing or have been too busy to do, you finally manage to do it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 最终找到时间做某事；抽空做某事
words.ex: I haven't gotten around to doing my homework yet.
words.ex_cn: 我还没抽出时间做作业。
words.en: If you get around to doing something that you have delayed doing or have been too busy to do, you finally manage to do it.

words.tr: phrase. v. （做坏事而）逃脱惩罚，侥幸成功
words.ex: He stole the money but got away with it.
words.ex_cn: 他偷了钱，但没有被发现。
words.en: To avoid being punished for something wrong that one has done.

words.tr: phrase. v. 惹人烦扰；使人心烦意乱；让人感到恼火
words.ex: Stop getting in my hair and let me work.
words.ex_cn: 别再烦我了，让我工作吧。
words.en: To annoy or bother someone, especially by being too close to them or by interfering with what they are doing.

words.tr: phrase. 陷入困境；遇到麻烦
words.ex: He gets into trouble when he doesn't listen to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 当他不听老师的话时，他就会陷入麻烦。
words.en: To get into trouble means to become involved in a situation where you are likely to be blamed or punished for something.

words.w: get off on the wrong foot
words.tr: phrase. 一开始就出错；一开始就关系不佳
words.uk: ɡet ɒf ɒn ðə rɒŋ fʊt
words.us: ɡɛt ɔf ɒn ðə rɔŋ fʊt
words.ex: They got off on the wrong foot when they first met.
words.ex_cn: 他们第一次见面时就产生了误会。
words.en: To start a relationship or project badly, often because of a misunderstanding or mistake.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （计划或想法）开始成功，取得进展；起飞（比喻用法）
words.ex: His business didn't get off the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他的生意没能起步。
words.en: If a project or activity gets off the ground or you get it off the ground, it starts or succeeds.

words.tr: 短语动词。下班；结束工作
words.ex: He gets off work at five o'clock every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天五点下班。
words.en: To leave one's place of employment at the end of the day.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人感到烦躁；使某人恼火
words.ex: The loud music next door gets on my nerves.
words.ex_cn: 隔壁的吵闹音乐让我很烦。
words.en: To irritate or annoy someone.

words.tr: 短语动词. 剪头发；理发
words.ex: He gets his hair cut every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都剪一次头发。
words.en: To have one's hair trimmed or styled by a professional.

words.tr: 短语动词. 剪头发；理发
words.ex: He has his hair cut every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都剪一次头发。
words.en: To get a haircut; to have someone cut one's hair.

words.tr: phrase. 剪头发
words.ex: He cuts his hair at home with scissors.
words.ex_cn: 他在家自己用剪刀剪头发。
words.en: To cut one's hair means to trim or shorten the hair on one's head, typically done by a professional or by oneself.

words.w: get one's hands full of sth.
words.tr: phrase. 使某人忙得不可开交；让某人完全忙于某事
words.uk: ɡet wʌnz hændz fʊl əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ɡet wʌnz hændz fʊl əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: I'm afraid I can't help you right now; I've got my hands full of work.
words.ex_cn: 恐怕我现在帮不了你；我手头上有许多工作要做。
words.en: To be very busy or have a lot of tasks to deal with.

words.tr: phrase. 获得报酬；得到薪水
words.ex: He gets paid every Friday for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五因工作而获得报酬。
words.en: To receive money for work done or services provided.

words.tr: phrase. 为...作准备
words.ex: He is getting ready for school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为上学做准备。
words.en: To prepare oneself for something that is going to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 开始做某事，着手进行
words.ex: It's time to get started on the project.
words.ex_cn: 是时候开始做这个项目了。
words.en: To begin to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 被卡住；被困住
words.ex: He gets stuck in traffic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都堵车。
words.en: To be unable to move or to be fixed in a particular position or situation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 从工作中获得休假时间；请到假
words.ex: She needs to get time off from work to attend her sister's wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她需要从工作中请假去参加她姐姐的婚礼。
words.en: Receive permission to be absent from one's job for a period.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事感到厌倦；厌烦某事物
words.ex: He gets tired of doing the same homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的作业。
words.en: To become bored or weary of something.

words.tr: phrase. 对做某事感到厌倦
words.ex: He gets tired of doing the same homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的作业。
words.en: To become bored or lose interest in doing something because it has been done too often or for too long.

words.tr: phrase. 做某事感到疲倦
words.ex: I get tired doing homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天做作业都感到累。
words.en: To become weary or bored with performing a particular activity.

words.tr: 短语动词. 入睡；开始睡觉
words.ex: I couldn't get to sleep last night because of the noise.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚因为噪音我无法入睡。
words.en: To succeed in falling asleep.

words.tr: phrase. 投降；屈服；让步
words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.tr: phrase. 发出（蒸汽、光等）
words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.tr: phrase. 别为难某人了；让某人歇会儿；对某人宽容一点
words.ex: Can you give me a break? I'm really trying my best.
words.ex_cn: 你能放过我吗？我真的在尽全力了。
words.en: To allow someone to have a rest or to stop being hard on someone.

words.tr: phrase. 给予某人帮助
words.ex: Can you give me a hand with this box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
words.en: To help someone with something.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助某人做某事；协助某人
words.uk: ɡɪv sʌm wʌn ə hænd wɪð
words.us: ɡɪv sʌm wʌn ə hænd wɪð
words.ex: Could you give me a hand with this heavy box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我搬一下这个重箱子吗？
words.en: To help someone with something.

words.tr: 动词短语，给某人退款
words.ex: If the product is defective, we will give you a refund.
words.ex_cn: 如果产品有缺陷，我们会给你退款。
words.en: To repay money to a customer for a returned product or service.

words.tr: 短语动词. 带某人一程去某地
words.uk: ɡɪv sʌm wʌn ə raɪd tuː
words.us: ɡɪv sʌm wʌn ə raɪd tu
words.ex: Can you give me a ride to the airport?
words.ex_cn: 你能带我去机场吗？
words.en: To take someone somewhere in a vehicle, especially as a favor or without charge.

words.tr: phrase. 给某人打电话
words.ex: I'll give you a ring when I arrive.
words.ex_cn: 我到了就给你打电话。
words.en: To call someone on the telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事而称赞某人；承认某人的功劳
words.ex: You have to give him credit for his persistence.
words.ex_cn: 你必须为他的坚持不懈而赞扬他。
words.en: To acknowledge or praise someone for something they have done.

words.tr: 短语动词. 考虑某事；对某事加以思考
words.ex: I'd like you to give this idea a thought before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 我希望你在做决定之前能考虑一下这个想法。
words.en: To consider or think about something, often briefly.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…放弃希望或努力；不再继续支持或尝试
words.ex: After failing the test several times, he decided to give up on his dream of becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: v. 在多次考试失败后，他决定放弃成为医生的梦想。
words.en: If you give up on something or someone, you stop trying to do or achieve something, or stop believing that they can succeed or improve.

words.tr: phrase. 冰川运动；冰川的移动过程
words.ex: The evidence of glacial movement can be seen in the deep grooves carved into the rock.
words.ex_cn: 冰川运动的证据可以从岩石上深深的刻痕中看到。
words.en: The slow movement of glaciers, often causing changes in the landscape.

words.tr: phrase. 神经胶质细胞（存在于神经系统中，对神经元起支持、保护和营养作用的细胞）
words.ex: Glial cells play a crucial role in maintaining the health of neurons.
words.ex_cn: 神经胶质细胞在维持神经元健康方面起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: A glial cell is a type of cell in the nervous system that supports neurons, providing them with nutrients and insulation among other functions.

words.tr: phrase. v. 灭绝；绝种
words.ex: Many animals may go extinct if we do not protect nature.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们不保护自然，许多动物可能会灭绝。
words.en: To die out completely and no longer exist as a species.

words.tr: phrase. 去慢跑；去跑步锻炼
words.ex: They decided to go jogging in the park early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定一大早在公园里去慢跑。
words.en: To go jogging means to run at a slow or steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.tr: phrase. v. （指成功、赞美或酒精等）使人变得骄傲、轻狂或头晕；使某人头脑发热
words.ex: Success can sometimes go to one's head and make them lose sight of their goals.
words.ex_cn: 成功有时会使人骄傲自满，让他们忘记了自己的目标。
words.en: If something such as success or praise goes to someone's head, it makes them feel proud and confident in a way that makes them less pleasant or less effective.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去健身房锻炼
words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: To visit a place where people exercise, typically with equipment.

words.w: go in one ear and out the other
words.tr: phrase. （信息）左耳进右耳出，听过后立刻忘记
words.uk: ɡəʊ ɪn wʌn ɪər ənd aʊt ði ˈʌðər
words.us: ɡoʊ ɪn wʌn ɪr ənd aʊt ði ˈʌðər
words.ex: When I tell him to clean his room, it goes in one ear and out the other.
words.ex_cn: 当我让他打扫房间时，他左耳进右耳出。
words.en: If something you hear goes in one ear and out the other, you do not remember it because you were not really listening or thinking about it.

words.w: be in one ear and out the other
words.tr: phrase. (信息或忠告)刚听进去就马上忘记，左耳进右耳出
words.uk: biː ɪn wʌn ɪər ænd aʊt ði ˈʌðər
words.us: bi ɪn wʌn ɪr ænd aʊt ði ˈʌðər
words.ex: No matter how many times I tell her to be careful, it's always in one ear and out the other.
words.ex_cn: 无论我告诉她多少次要小心，她总是左耳进右耳出。
words.en: If you say that something you tell someone goes in one ear and out the other, you mean that they pay no attention to it.

words.tr: phrase. 穿过；走过
words.ex: We go across the street every morning to buy bread.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上过街去买面包。
words.en: To move from one side to the other of something such as a river, road, or border.

words.tr: phrase. 步行穿过；横穿
words.ex: He walks across the street every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上走过街道。
words.en: To move over or along on foot; traverse.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然碰见；撞见
words.ex: I run across my old friend at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To meet or find someone or something by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 黄金储备；国家或银行所持有的黄金存量
words.ex: The gold reserve is a crucial element in maintaining the stability of a country's currency.
words.ex_cn: 黄金储备是维持一个国家货币稳定的关键因素。
words.en: Gold reserve refers to the stock of gold held by a country's central bank or treasury as a financial asset.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的声誉；好名声
words.ex: He has a good reputation for being honest.
words.ex_cn: 他因诚实而享有良好的声誉。
words.en: A good reputation refers to the general opinion that people have about someone or something, based on their behavior or character.

words.tr: phrase. 坏名声；不良声誉
words.ex: The company has a bad reputation for failing to deliver on time.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司因未能按时交货而声名狼藉。
words.en: A bad reputation is the general belief that someone or something is not good.

words.tr: 短语. 有时间吗？/ 你知道现在几点吗？
words.ex: Excuse me, do you got the time?
words.ex_cn: 打扰一下，你知道现在几点吗？
words.en: An informal way to ask someone for the current time.

words.tr: phrase. 精品咖啡；优质咖啡
words.ex: Gourmet coffee is often served in specialty cafes.
words.ex_cn: 精品咖啡经常在特色咖啡馆供应。
words.en: Gourmet coffee refers to coffee that is made from high-quality beans and is carefully roasted and brewed to enhance its flavor.

words.tr: phrase. 政府机构；政府部门
words.ex: The government agency gives money to schools.
words.ex_cn: 政府机构向学校提供资金。
words.en: A government agency is an organization or body that is part of the government and is responsible for the administration of specific functions, such as regulation, service provision, or enforcement of laws.

words.tr: phrase. 毕业公告；毕业通知（用于告知他人某人已完成学业并取得学位的正式通知或卡片）
words.ex: They sent graduation announcements to their friends and family.
words.ex_cn: 他们给朋友和家人寄了毕业通知。
words.en: Formal notices sent to inform people of a graduation ceremony.

words.tr: phrase. 毕业典礼
words.ex: My brother walked at the graduation ceremony last week.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥上周参加了毕业典礼。
words.en: A graduation ceremony is an event where students receive their academic degrees or diplomas.

words.tr: phrase. 大峡谷（美国著名自然景观）
words.ex: The Grand Canyon is one of the most spectacular natural wonders in the world.
words.ex_cn: 大峡谷是世界上最壮观的自然奇观之一。
words.en: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. It is known for its overwhelming size and its intricate and colorful landscape.

words.tr: phrase. 同意某人的请求；批准某人的要求
words.ex: The manager was willing to grant one's request for a day off.
words.ex_cn: 经理愿意同意某人请一天假的请求。
words.en: To agree to someone's request or demand.

words.tr: phrase. 同意请求；批准申请
words.ex: The teacher will grant a request if it is reasonable.
words.ex_cn: 如果请求合理，老师会批准的。
words.en: To agree to a request or demand.

words.tr: phrase. 急切地抓住；试图抓住（常用于比喻意义，如抓住机会或希望）
words.ex: He grasps at the rope to climb up.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住绳子往上爬。
words.en: To make an attempt to seize something or to accept an opportunity eagerly.

words.tr: phrase. 万有引力
words.ex: The gravitational force pulls the apple down from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 重力把苹果从树上拉下来。
words.en: The force of attraction that exists between any two masses, any two bodies, any two particles.

words.tr: phrase. 大萧条（指1929年至1930年代全球经济严重衰退的时期）
words.ex: The Great Depression was a severe worldwide economic depression that took place during the 1930s.
words.ex_cn: 大萧条是一场发生在20世纪30年代的全球性严重经济衰退。
words.en: The Great Depression refers to the severe worldwide economic depression that took place during the 1930s. The timing of the Great Depression varied across nations; in most countries it started in 1929 and lasted until the late 1930s. It was the longest, deepest, and most widespread depression of the 20th century.

words.tr: phrase. 贺卡；问候卡
words.ex: She sent me a beautiful greeting card on my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她在我的生日时送了我一张漂亮的贺卡。
words.en: A greeting card is a piece of card, often with a picture on the front and a message inside, which you give to someone on a special occasion.

words.tr: phrase. 抱怨...
words.ex: He always groans about homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都抱怨作业。
words.en: To complain in a low, deep voice about something.

words.tr: phrase. 种植大麻（指工业用大麻，通常为低THC含量的品种）
words.ex: They grow hemp on a small farm.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个小农场种植大麻。
words.en: To cultivate hemp plants, typically for their fiber, seeds, or medicinal properties.

words.tr: phrase. 长大；成熟；成长
words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.tr: phrase. 健身房通行证；允许进入健身房的凭证或会员卡
words.ex: With a gym pass, you can access all the facilities during your membership period.
words.ex_cn: 有了健身房通行证，你可以在会员期间使用所有设施。
words.en: A gym pass is a card or ticket that allows you access to a gym or fitness center.

words.tr: adj. （尤指药物毒品等）易上瘾的；易成习惯的
words.ex: This substance is highly habit-forming.
words.ex_cn: 这种物质极易上瘾。
words.en: If something is habit-forming, it is likely to make you want to do it or have it often, because you enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 栖息地破坏；指自然环境被破坏，导致生物无法正常生存的现象
words.ex: Animals lose their homes because of habitat destruction.
words.ex_cn: 动物因为栖息地破坏而失去了家园。
words.en: Habitat destruction refers to the process by which natural habitat is rendered functionally unable to support the species present. In this process, the organisms that previously used the site are displaced or destroyed, reducing biodiversity.

words.tr: phrase. 打五折的；减价一半的
words.ex: The store is offering items half off for the holiday sale.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在假期促销中提供半价商品。
words.en: If something is half off, it is being sold at half its usual price.

words.tr: phrase. 交上；提交；呈递
words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；给予
words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: adj. 传下来的；现成而价廉质次的; n. 传下来的东西；现成的廉价衣服
words.ex: She wore a hand-me-down dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件传下来的衣服去参加聚会。
words.en: A hand-me-down is a piece of clothing or other item that has been passed on from one person to another, especially because the original owner no longer wants or needs it.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；绝对地
words.ex: He is hands down the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里毫无疑问最好的球员。
words.en: Without any doubt; easily.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.tr: phrase. 发生在...人身上；碰巧
words.ex: What will happen to the dog if we go on vacation?
words.ex_cn: 如果我们去度假，那只狗会怎么样？
words.en: If something happens to someone or something, it occurs or takes place, often by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 坚定不妥协的立场；强硬路线
words.ex: The government has taken a hard line on immigration.
words.ex_cn: 政府在移民问题上采取了强硬立场。
words.en: A firm and uncompromising policy or stance.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎没有人注意到
words.ex: Hardly anyone has noticed the subtle changes in the company's policy.
words.ex_cn: 几乎没有人注意到公司政策的微妙变化。
words.en: Almost no one has observed or realized something.

words.tr: 有机会做某事
words.ex: I hope to have a chance to visit Paris next year.
words.ex_cn: 我希望明年有机会去巴黎旅游。
words.en: To have the opportunity to do something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 食欲很好；胃口大
words.ex: After the hike, I have a big appetite and could eat a horse.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行后，我有很大的胃口，能吃下一匹马。
words.en: To have a strong desire or capacity for food.

words.tr: 短语. 食欲不振；胃口不好
words.ex: He has a poor appetite and eats very little every day.
words.ex_cn: 他食欲很差，每天吃得很少。
words.en: To have little desire to eat, often due to illness or stress.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有做某事的习惯；经常做某事
words.ex: He has a habit of drinking coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他有每天早上喝咖啡的习惯。
words.en: If you have a habit of doing something, you do it regularly or often, especially in a way that is difficult to stop.

words.tr: 短语动词，善于应付（某类人或事物）；有处理……的技巧
words.ex: He has a way with words.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长用词。
words.en: To have a natural ability to deal with or handle a particular type of person or thing effectively.

words.tr: 短语. 祝你……旅途愉快（用于祝福他人旅途顺利，中间可填入 good, nice, wonderful 等形容词）
words.ex: I hope you have a nice trip.
words.ex_cn: 希望你旅途愉快。
words.en: Used to wish someone a safe and enjoyable journey.

words.tr: 短语. 拥有充沛的精力
words.ex: He has abundant energy after sleeping well.
words.ex_cn: 他睡得好后精力充沛。
words.en: To possess a large amount of physical or mental strength.

words.tr: 短语动词，对……掌握不利证据；知道……的把柄；在……方面有不利信息
words.ex: Do you have anything on the suspect?
words.ex_cn: 你知道有关嫌疑人的任何情况吗？
words.en: To possess information or evidence about someone or something, often used to imply leverage or control.

words.tr: 短语动词，拥有某人的地址；知道某人的住址
words.ex: I have my friend's address.
words.ex_cn: 我有我朋友的地址。
words.en: To know someone's location or contact details, often implying the ability to reach or find them.

words.tr: phrase. 在...方面有问题
words.ex: He has problems with reading English words.
words.ex_cn: 他在读英语单词方面有困难。
words.en: To experience difficulties or issues with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 有权做某事；有权利进行某种行为
words.ex: Everyone has right to do what they think is right.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权做他们认为正确的事。
words.en: To be legally or morally entitled to perform a specific action.

words.tr: 短语动词，有空间容纳……；有余地接受……
words.ex: We have room for one more person in the car.
words.ex_cn: 我们的车里还能再坐一个人。
words.en: If something has room for a particular thing, it has enough space or time to include it.

words.tr: phrase. 有权做某事；有权力或权限去做某事
words.ex: The manager has the authority to approve the request.
words.ex_cn: 经理有权批准这个请求。
words.en: To have the power or right to do something.

words.tr: 短语动词，有时间做某事
words.ex: I have time to do the laundry this evening.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚有时间洗衣服。
words.en: If you have time to do something, you are not busy and are able to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 与...有关
words.ex: This problem has to do with counting money.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数钱有关。
words.en: to be connected or associated with something

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得进入……的机会；获得对……的使用权
words.ex: He managed to gain access to the restricted area.
words.ex_cn: 他设法获得了进入限制区域的权限。
words.en: To obtain the right or opportunity to use or enter something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 剪头发
words.ex: I need to have a haircut before the interview.
words.ex_cn: v. 我需要在面试前去理发。
words.en: To have a haircut means to have your hair cut by a professional or to cut your hair yourself.

words.tr: 短语动词. 剪头发；理发
words.ex: He got a haircut yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天去剪了头发。
words.en: To have one's hair cut by a professional.

words.tr: phrase. v. 朝…行进；前往
words.ex: He heads for the station every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上前往车站。
words.en: To move or travel towards a particular place or direction.

words.tr: phrase. 迎面地
words.ex: The two cars collided head on.
words.ex_cn: 两辆车迎面相撞。
words.en: In a direct and often confrontational manner.

words.tr: 短语动词. 走到；前往；去（某地）
words.ex: Why don't we head over to the coffee shop?
words.ex_cn: 我们为什么不去咖啡店呢？
words.en: To go to a place, especially quickly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 听说
words.ex: I just heard about the new park in town.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚听说了镇上的新公园。
words.en: To become aware of something through being told about it.

words.tr: phrase. 听说
words.ex: I have never heard of that song before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前从未听说过那首歌。
words.en: To become aware of something through hearing about it from someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 供暖系统
words.ex: The heating system broke last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天供暖系统坏了。
words.en: A heating system is a mechanism for maintaining temperatures at an acceptable level; by using thermal energy within a home, office, or other dwelling.

words.tr: phrase. 交通拥堵；繁忙的交通
words.ex: There is heavy traffic on the road after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后路上交通很拥堵。
words.en: A situation where there are so many vehicles on a road that they move very slowly or cannot move at all.

words.tr: phrase. v. 自取所需；随便享用（食物或饮料）
words.ex: Please help yourself to some cookies on the table.
words.ex_cn: 请随意吃一些桌上的饼干。
words.en: To take something for oneself without asking for permission, often used when offering something to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助解决困难
words.ex: He helps out at the store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在商店帮忙。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something or in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 犹豫去做某事；对做某事感到迟疑
words.ex: Don't hesitate to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 不要犹豫寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate to do something, you delay doing it or are unwilling to do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried about it.

words.tr: phrase. 历史视角；历史的观点或看法
words.ex: Understanding the historical perspective of a country can help us comprehend its current policies.
words.ex_cn: 了解一个国家的历史视角可以帮助我们理解其当前的政策。
words.en: A historical perspective involves looking at events, ideas, or phenomena from the point of view of their historical context, considering how they have developed over time and how they relate to the present.

words.tr: phrase. 历史意义；历史重要性
words.ex: The historical significance of the event cannot be overstated.
words.ex_cn: 这个事件的历史意义不容小觑。
words.en: Historical significance refers to the importance of an event, person, or artifact in history, often influencing future events or societal development.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧抓住；坚持；保持
words.ex: Please hold on to the handrail when the bus starts.
words.ex_cn: 当公共汽车启动时，请抓紧扶手。
words.en: To hold on to something means to keep it in your possession or to not let it go, often because it is valuable or important to you.

words.tr: phrase. v. 延期；延长（会议、假期等）；继续保留
words.ex: They decided to hold over the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone or delay something; to continue to use, show, or do something.

words.tr: phrase. 怀恨在心；记仇；对某人长期心存怨恨
words.ex: He won't hold the grudge against his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他不会对弟弟怀恨在心。
words.en: To continue to feel resentment or anger towards someone for a past wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 家用无线电接收器；家庭收音机接收装置
words.ex: He bought a new home radio receiver to listen to his favorite radio programs.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一台新的家用收音机来收听他喜欢的广播节目。
words.en: A device used in households to receive radio broadcasts, allowing users to listen to music, news, and other audio content.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭作业任务；教师布置给学生在课外完成的作业
words.ex: The teacher gave a challenging homework assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师布置了一项具有挑战性的家庭作业任务。
words.en: A task or piece of work assigned to a student as part of their studies, typically to be completed outside of class.

words.tr: phrase. 水平运动
words.ex: The horizontal movement of the conveyor belt carries the packages forward.
words.ex_cn: 传送带的水平移动将包裹向前输送。
words.en: Movement in a plane parallel to the horizon or to the baseline of a structure.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭用具；家用器具
words.ex: She carefully arranged the household utensils in the kitchen cabinets.
words.ex_cn: 她小心地将家用器具整理在厨房的橱柜里。
words.en: A household utensil is any tool or container used in the home, especially in the kitchen.

words.tr: phrase. 住房办公室；负责管理或分配住房的机构
words.ex: The housing office assists residents with their housing applications.
words.ex_cn: 房屋管理处协助居民处理住房申请。
words.en: An office that deals with matters related to housing, such as leases, maintenance, and tenant issues.

words.tr: 用于提出建议或征求意见，意为“……怎么样？”或“……好吗？”
words.ex: How about we go to the park?
words.ex_cn: 我们去公园怎么样？
words.en: Used to make a suggestion or to ask for someone's opinion on a particular matter.

words.tr: phrase. 巨大的爆炸；猛烈的爆破
words.ex: The huge explosion caused widespread destruction.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的爆炸造成了广泛的破坏。
words.en: A very large and powerful explosion that can cause significant damage or be heard from a great distance.

words.tr: phrase. 人类种族；人类整体
words.ex: The human race must protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 人类必须保护环境。
words.en: The human race refers to all the people who live on the Earth, considered as a group.

words.tr: phrase. 赶紧；快点
words.ex: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to hurry up, you are telling them to do something more quickly than they were doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 水热喷口；海底热泉，指在海底裂隙处喷出高温热液的地质结构
words.ex: Scientists have discovered new species of marine life around hydrothermal vents.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在热液喷口附近发现了新的海洋生物物种。
words.en: A hydrothermal vent is a fissure on the seafloor from which geothermally heated water issues.

words.tr:
v. 敢说；
n. 打赌；赌注；
words.ex: I bet you didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说你不知道那件事。
words.en: If you bet on the result of a horse race, football game, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

words.tr:
n. 疑问；疑惑；
v. 怀疑；拿不准；
words.ex: I have doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案有疑问。
words.en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say that something is beyond doubt, you mean that it is definitely true.

words.tr: 我想做……（表达愿望或意愿的常用句型）
words.ex: I'd like to do my homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我想晚饭后做作业。
words.en: A polite expression used to state a desire or intention to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 同情；将…视为
words.ex: Many readers identify with the main character's struggles.
words.ex_cn: 许多读者对主角的挣扎感同身受。
words.en: If you identify with someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings and ideas.

words.tr: v. 识别；确认；鉴定；
words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.tr: phrase. 要是…就好了
words.ex: If only I had more time, I would finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 要是我有更多时间，我就能完成作业了。
words.en: used to express a wish that something had happened differently or that something would happen

words.tr: phrase. 火成岩（由岩浆冷却凝固形成的岩石）
words.ex: Igneous rocks are formed from the solidification of magma.
words.ex_cn: 火成岩是由岩浆的凝固形成的。
words.en: Igneous rock is one of the three main rock types, formed through the cooling and solidification of magma or lava.

words.tr: phrase. 非法收入；违法所得
words.ex: He was arrested for his illegal earnings from drug trafficking.
words.ex_cn: 他因从毒品交易中获得非法收入而被捕。
words.en: Money or income obtained through illegal activities.

words.tr: phrase. 违章停车；违法停车
words.ex: The police issued a ticket for illegal parking.
words.ex_cn: 警察因违法停车开出了罚单。
words.en: The act of parking a vehicle in a place or in a manner that is not allowed by law.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己沉浸于；专心于；埋头于
words.ex: He likes to immerse himself in simple books every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上沉浸在简单的书籍中。
words.en: To involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 免疫防御；机体抵御病原体入侵的免疫反应机制
words.ex: The immune defense system is crucial for protecting the body against pathogens.
words.ex_cn: 免疫防御系统对于保护身体免受病原体的侵害至关重要。
words.en: The biological mechanisms within an organism that protect against disease by identifying and killing pathogens and tumor cells.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的影响
words.ex: The new policy had a significant impact on the economy.
words.ex_cn: 新政策对经济产生了重大影响。
words.en: To have an effect or influence on someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 内隐记忆；指个体在无意识状态下自动激活、无需有意回忆即可影响行为或表现的记忆系统
words.ex: Implicit memory allows us to perform tasks without conscious thought.
words.ex_cn: 隐式记忆使我们能够在无意识的情况下执行任务。
words.en: Implicit memory is a type of memory in which previous experiences aid in the performance of a task without conscious awareness of these previous experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 把…硬加给；利用；欺骗；勉强（某人）做事
words.ex: They should not impose on others without asking first.
words.ex_cn: 他们不应该在没有询问的情况下强加于人。
words.en: To impose on someone means to ask them to do something that may be inconvenient or troublesome for them.

words.tr: phrase. 提高某人的成绩；提升某人的分数
words.ex: He studies hard to improve his grade in math.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以提高他的数学成绩。
words.en: To make one's academic performance better, especially in terms of grades or marks.

words.tr: n. 改进；改善；
words.ex: There was a big improvement in his English skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平有了很大改进。
words.en: The act of making something better or the state of being made better; an example or instance of this.

words.tr: phrase. 在竞赛中；在比赛中；在争夺中
words.ex: He performed admirably in contest.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中表现出色。
words.en: Competing in a competition or rivalry.

words.tr: phrase. 在……竞赛中；在……比赛里
words.ex: He is in a spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个拼写比赛。
words.en: Competing in a specific type of competition or rivalry.

words.tr: phrase. 以狂怒的方式；极其猛烈地；愤怒地
words.ex: She slammed the door shut in a furious way.
words.ex_cn: 她愤怒地砰的一声关上了门。
words.en: In a manner that is intensely angry, passionate, or energetic.

words.tr: phrase. 心情好；情绪愉快；处于好心情
words.ex: She was in a good mood after receiving the good news.
words.ex_cn: 收到好消息后，她心情愉快。
words.en: If you are in a good mood, you feel cheerful and happy.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙；乐意地
words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry, you are doing something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.tr: phrase. 混乱；一团糟；陷于窘境
words.ex: His room is in a mess.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间乱七八糟。
words.en: If something is in a mess, it is in a state of confusion or disorder.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种意义上
words.ex: In a sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: You say in a sense to indicate that a statement is true in one way, but not in others.

words.tr: phrase. 除…之外
words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.tr: phrase. 提前；预先
words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 在各个方面；全面地；全方位地
words.ex: The project was successful in all aspects.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目在各个方面都很成功。
words.en: Considering every part or feature of something.

words.tr: phrase. 极有可能；十有八九；几乎可以肯定
words.ex: In all likelihood, the project will be completed on time.
words.ex_cn: 很有可能，项目会按时完成。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in all likelihood, you mean that it will probably happen.

words.tr: phrase. 拥有权力的；当权的；主管的
words.ex: The teacher is in authority in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里拥有权力。
words.en: Having official power or control over others; in a position of command.

words.tr: phrase. 简单地说；简而言之；简单扼要地
words.ex: In brief, he likes soccer.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢足球。
words.en: In a few words; concisely.

words.tr: phrase. 万一；以防
words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.tr: phrase. 与…联合；与…结成联盟
words.ex: The two parties are working in coalition with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个政党正在联合合作。
words.en: In cooperation or alliance with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 共有
words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 与…竞争；在与…的竞争中
words.ex: He is in competition with his brother for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和他弟弟竞争这份奖学金。
words.en: If you are in competition with someone, you are trying to do better than they are in a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 与…冲突；与…矛盾；与…不一致
words.ex: He is in conflict with his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他和老板有冲突。
words.en: If one idea or opinion is in conflict with another, they are very different.

words.tr: phrase. 因此；结果
words.ex: He forgot his homework, in consequence, he got a bad grade.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了做作业，结果得了低分。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；因为；鉴于……的结果
words.ex: He was late in consequence of the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于大雨，他迟到了。
words.en: As a result of; because of.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持联系；与…接触；与…有往来
words.ex: He is in contact with his teacher every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都和老师保持联系。
words.en: If you are in contact with someone, you communicate with them regularly, for example by telephone or letter.

words.tr: phrase. 处于灭绝的危险中；濒临灭绝
words.ex: The panda is in danger of extinction.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫濒临灭绝。
words.en: At risk of no longer existing, especially referring to species.

words.tr: phrase. 详细地
words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的时候；到时候；最终
words.ex: He will get the results in due course.
words.ex_cn: 他会在适当的时候收到结果。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or take place in due course, you mean that it will happen or take place at the appropriate time, not before.

words.tr: phrase. 交换；以此易彼
words.ex: He gave me a book in exchange for a pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本书换了我的钢笔。
words.en: If you give or do something in exchange for something else, you give or do it in order to get that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同；支持；有利于
words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 与优秀的人或情况为伍；并不孤单（指许多有地位、有才智或处境相同的人也有类似经历）
words.ex: He is in good company when he works with kind people.
words.ex_cn: 当他和善良的人一起工作时，他身处良伴之中。
words.en: If you say that someone is in good company, you mean that they should not feel ashamed or embarrassed about something because many other people have done the same thing.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.tr: phrase. 仿效；模仿；以…为榜样
words.ex: He drew a picture in imitation of his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅画，模仿他哥哥的。
words.en: If you do something in imitation of someone else, you copy their actions or behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 成一直线；一致；协调；有秩序
words.ex: The books are placed in line on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地排成一条直线放在书架上。
words.en: If people or things are in line, they are arranged in a line or a row.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.tr: phrase. 在运动中的；处于活动状态的；运转中的
words.ex: The car is in motion on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在路上行驶。
words.en: If something is in motion, it is moving.

words.tr: phrase. 立刻；马上
words.ex: He finished his homework in no time.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就完成了作业。
words.en: Very quickly or soon.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的一生中；在有生之年
words.ex: He has never seen a bear in his lifetime.
words.ex_cn: 他一生中从未见过熊。
words.en: During the period of time that someone is alive.

words.tr: phrase. 处于某人的位置；设身处地；代替某人
words.ex: If I were in your place, I would take the job.
words.ex_cn: 如果我处在你的位置，我会接受这份工作。
words.en: If you say that you would do something in someone else's place, you mean that you would do it if you were in their situation.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…
words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.tr: phrase. 换句话说
words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 尤其；特别
words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
